title: The AAA Collapse, the Bangalore Axiom, and the Curation Oracle
transcript: The instinct of the 20th-century artisan or patent attorney is to play it close to the chest: keep the trade secret, hide the repo, register the copyright, hoard the prompt. In October 2026, that instinct is a corpse that has not realized it stopped breathing. Frontier models have flattened the global cognitive gradient. The knowledge required to make a spatial compiler, reverse an engine blob, or synthesize a living game world is not proprietary; it was already trained into the weights of Gemini, Claude, and their peers. What was missing was only the harness and the hands.
